title_zh: AI 原点照护环最小 P0 证据包
title_en: AI Origin Care Loop Minimum P0 Evidence Pack

selected_node.selection_reason_zh: 优先验证居民日常与人工等价入口；不依赖 PROV-KEY-003 的大钟寺站点锚点，也不需要先放行企业车辆扩容。
selected_node.selection_reason_en: Prioritises daily resident access and a human-equivalent entry; it does not depend on the unresolved Dazhongsi anchor or require enterprise-vehicle expansion.
selected_node.spatial_scope_zh: 一条普通步行链、一条无障碍替代链、一个人工服务台候选和一个轨道/公交交接点；正式范围由现场专业走查确认。
selected_node.spatial_scope_en: One ordinary walking chain, one accessible alternative, one candidate human desk and one rail/bus handoff; field professionals confirm the final scope.

evidence_streams.template: 15-minute directional counts by mode and service-purpose group; no device ID or continuous trace
evidence_streams.minimum_design_target: two comparable weekdays plus one stress or event window before calibration
evidence_streams.release_rule: date, weather, counter role and missing interval recorded

evidence_streams.template: segment ID, width/gradient/crossing/obstruction, alternate route, affected-group observation and photo-rights state
evidence_streams.minimum_design_target: ordinary and accessible chains both walked in day and night windows with invited user review
evidence_streams.release_rule: a broken segment stays UNKNOWN and blocks P1

evidence_streams.template: owner role, receiver role, service window, clearance action, fire/access route and restoration receipt
evidence_streams.minimum_design_target: every proposed enterprise window has one accepted receiver and one public-route restoration check

evidence_streams.template: staffed/phone/paper entry, rail/bus alternative, handoff time, missed-connection response and no-device route
evidence_streams.minimum_design_target: one end-to-end rehearsal per time window including outage and severe weather
evidence_streams.release_rule: no available takeover means service stays stopped

evidence_streams.template: purpose, grouped fields, collection owner, access role, retention, deletion receipt and public algorithm note
evidence_streams.minimum_design_target: all fields have a purpose and expiry before collection
evidence_streams.release_rule: unnecessary personal or persistent identifier blocks collection

evidence_streams.template: resident, carer, disabled-user and night-worker review of group denominator, forced detour, rejection, waiting and appeal pause
evidence_streams.minimum_design_target: each named affected group can disagree, request correction and see the response
evidence_streams.release_rule: a hidden decline or unresolved objection blocks expansion

evidence_streams.template: current state, owner role, ordinary alternative, incident/appeal count, repair debt, next review and withdrawal receipt
evidence_streams.minimum_design_target: one readable board plus paper/phone correction route
evidence_streams.release_rule: unresolved repair debt or inaccessible status keeps BLACKOUT

calibration_contract.replacement_rule: Every synthetic input is replaced only by a dated, scoped and versioned field record; missing cells remain unknown and never become zero.
invalid_model_conditions: observed mode or queue falls outside declared model objects
affected group reports an unmodeled barrier

release_gates.name: scope_and_rights
release_gates.reason: field scope and material/image rights not confirmed

release_gates.name: accessible_and_human_fallback
release_gates.reason: zero day/night walk or takeover receipts

release_gates.name: participatory_review_and_closeout
release_gates.reason: zero affected-group sign-offs or public closeouts

negative_fixtures.condition: enterprise request exists but resident return is missing
average improves while one affected group declines
accessible segment is unknown or night fallback has no receiver
field row lacks date, scope, denominator or deletion owner
repair debt or appeal remains unresolved at closeout
